verdict.rationale: Glama's hosting lets you deploy a Dockerfile, npm/PyPI package, or GitHub repo as a hosted MCP server with the Gateway automatically wired in, so custom code can become a hosted MCP endpoint without protocol plumbing (glama-docs-2, glama-docs-3, glama-docs-15, glama-docs-27). However there is no evidence of an OpenAPI-spec-to-MCP-server conversion feature — the docs never mention ingesting an OpenAPI definition to auto-generate a server. Missing for 10: OpenAPI import/definition-to-MCP generation, independent confirmation of the code-to-server build pipeline working smoothly.
